use_case_summary: Build a semantic search + reranking pipeline for an e-commerce catalog to increase conversion on long-tail queries while keeping cost-per-query under strict threshold during seasonal spikes.
requirements_summary: Indexing scale: must handle 12M SKUs and incremental nightly updates (~200k changes/day).
Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end search + rerank < 200ms for non-emb pipeline; acceptable p99 < 600ms during peaks if service degradation is graceful.
Throughput/peaks: baseline 30 QPS, expected Black Friday peak ~250 QPS sustained 2 hours, burst to 1k QPS for 5-minute windows.
Cost target: blended cost-per-query (embeddings+rerank+storage) target <$0.002 for conversions; willing to pay more for critical traffic tiers but needs visibility.
Model preference: open quantized embedding models for cost + dedicated reranker (fine-tuned monoBERT-like) for top-k reordering.
Routing/fallback: multi-tier routing, fallback to smaller cheaper model when dedicated capacity saturated; must preserve result quality.
indexing_scale_expected: ~12M canonical SKUs, ~28M listing variants, nightly delta ~200k
latency_throughput_targets: 95th < 200ms; p99 < 600ms; baseline 30 QPS; sustained peak 250 QPS; short bursts to 1k QPS
seasonal_spike_profile: Black Friday / Holiday: 6–8x baseline for 6 hours; occasional 20x micro-bursts around campaigns
routing_requirements: Prefer smart routing: small hosted embed model for cold queries, dedicated high-throughput embedding + rerank for hot routes; automated fallback to smaller reranker when capacity constrained.
